text:
<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Hello, how are you?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
प्रणाम, कोना छी?
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am fine, thank you.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम ठीक छी, धन्यवाद।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: What is your name?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
अहाँक नाम की अछि?
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My name is Rohan.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर नाम रोहन अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Where do you live?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
अहाँ कतए रहैत छी?
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I live in Darbhanga.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम दरभंगामे रहैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am hungry.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमरा भूख लागल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am very tired today.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ हम बड्ड थाकल छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Please come here.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कृपया एतए आउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I will go to the market tomorrow.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम काल्हि बजार जाएब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: She went to school yesterday.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ओ काल्हि स्कूल गेल छल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: He is cooking food.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ओ खाना बना रहल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The weather is very hot today.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ मौसम बड्ड गर्म अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Please give me water.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कृपया हमरा पानि दिअ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I love my family.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम अपन परिवारसँ बड्ड प्रेम करैत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The food is very delicious.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ई खाना बड्ड स्वादिष्ट अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I could not sleep last night.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
काल्हि राति हमरा नींद नहि आएल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My mother makes very good food.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर माए बड्ड नीक खाना बनबैत छथि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: When will you come home?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
अहाँ घर कखन आएब?
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I will return by evening.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम साँझ धरि घुरि आएब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Do you understand Maithili?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
अहाँ मैथिली बुझैत छी?
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am learning Maithili.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम मैथिली सीखि रहल छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The child is crying.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
बच्चा कानि रहल अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Please sit down.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कृपया बैसू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: It will rain today.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ बर्खा होएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I miss my village.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमरा अपन गाम बड्ड याद आबैत अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My father works in the field.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर बाबूजी खेतमे काज करैत छथि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I have two brothers and one sister.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमरा दू भाई आ एक बहिन अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: This book is mine.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ई किताब हमर अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Where is the key?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
चाबी कतए अछि?
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The key is on the table.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
चाबी टेबुलपर अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am going to sleep now.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम एखन सुतए जाइत छी।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Wake me up at six in the morning.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
भिनसर छह बजे उठा दिअ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I got a job today.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ हमरा नौकरी भेटल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Congratulations!
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
बहुत बधाई हो!
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am not feeling well.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
तबियत ठीक नहि अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Please call the doctor.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कृपया डॉक्टरकेँ बजाउ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: How much does this cost?
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
एकर दाम कतेक अछि?
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: This is too expensive.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
ई बड्ड महग अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Give me a discount.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
कनेक कम करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I will come again tomorrow.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम काल्हि फेर आएब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Take care of yourself.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
अपन ध्यान राखब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I am proud of you.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमरा अहाँपर गर्व अछि।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Don't worry.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
चिंता नहि करू।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Everything will be fine.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
सब ठीक भए जाएत।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I forgot my umbrella at home.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर छाता घरमे रहि गेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: The train is late today.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
आइ गाड़ी देरीसँ आएल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I studied the whole night.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम राति भरि पढ़लहुँ।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: My sister got married last month.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हमर बहिनक बियाह पछिला महीना भेल।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: I will call you later.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
हम अहाँकेँ बाद मे फोन करब।
<end_of_turn>

<start_of_turn>user
Translate to Maithili: Goodbye, see you tomorrow.
<end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
विदा, काल्हि भेँट होएत।
<end_of_turn>
